title: test(service-automation): stub the host lookup in the http-nodes failed-call suite
body:

_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9DDypKu7B9nwbu5WuV7AEio8)_

Fixes #38126
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 用户无感:只改了自动化服务里一个测试文件,产品代码与线上行为都不变。
- 为什么做:消除一个偶发失败的测试,它依赖真实域名解析,CI 上解析慢时会超时变红。
- 出错会怎样:最坏是这个测试本身再变红,不影响任何用户,可以直接撤回。
- 要你做什么:无。

## What changes

`packages/services/service-automation/src/builtin/http-nodes.test.ts` only (+25 / -3). In the describe `http (canonical node) — a failed call names its host and cause`, `run()` no longer falls back to `defaultEgressGuard()` (whose resolver is the real `dns.promises.lookup`). It hands the node the **real** egress guard, `createEgressGuard({ policy: createEnvEgressPolicy({ allowedTargets: '127.0.0.1' }), resolve })`, through the existing `registerHttpNodes(..., { egress })` seam and the guard's own `resolve` option (documented "DNS override (tests)"; same pattern as `http-node-egress-guard.test.ts`). The stub resolver answers an ENOTFOUND-shaped error for `no-such-host.invalid` and throws on any other name; it records every name asked.

- The refusal text assertion and the "nothing of the lookup" assertion (`not.toContain('ENOTFOUND')`) are unchanged.
- The two cases that name `no-such-host.invalid` (unknown host; path/query/userinfo secrets) now also assert the stub answered the lookup (`lookups` equals `['no-such-host.invalid']`).
- ECONNREFUSED and timeout cases stay real undici against a real loopback socket: an IP literal never reaches the resolver.
- No product change: `http-nodes.ts` and the egress guard are untouched.

Every other case in the file was checked for a host lookup: `example.test` / `api.test` cases use `stubbedFetchEgress()` or the durable outbox (no fetch); `example.invalid` in the missing-url case never sends. The DNS-off run below records zero lookups for the whole file.

## Tests

- `http-nodes.test.ts`: 19/19 passed, normally and with DNS disabled.
- Control on `origin/main`'s version with every name lookup made to hang (the CI shape): the two cases time out at 5000 ms, two lookups of `no-such-host.invalid` recorded.
- Ablation: stub resolving `no-such-host.invalid` to a public address (93.184.215.14) turns both cases red; restored byte-identical.
- Package: `@objectstack/service-automation` typecheck (incl. `check:test-typecheck`) green; full vitest 297/297 files, 4342/4342 tests.

## Acceptance notes

- `skip-changeset`: test-only diff. `files[]` is `dist`, `README.md`, `CHANGELOG.md`; after a build, the new test symbols have zero hits in `dist/`, and the positive control (`defaultEgressGuard`) has hits.
